summary: Verified 2026-08-25 architectural gates: (1) ambiguity-gate on POST /cto/tasks/submit correctly returns {ok:false, needs_clarification:true, message:...} for 6 vague inputs and passes through 3 concrete inputs (concrete correctly hits the known GitHub-App-access error on fixture p_norepotest — expected). (2) Reachability-scope gate in services/mode_d_debugger.py::run_debug_session — direct pytest with read_file monkey-patched to return None on a plausible stack-trace referring to src/pages/DoesNotExist.jsx returns clarify:True with the honest 'I don't see that in your connected repo' reply and NO fabricated diagnosis (can_auto_fix=False, commit_task=''). (3) OAuthFinish.jsx now labels the missing-token redirect using the `provider` fragment param — verified 3 scenarios (#none → /login?github=missing_token, #provider=google → /login?google=missing_token, #provider=github → /login?github=missing_token). (4) google_oauth.py callback source includes `&provider=google` in success redirect. (5) useRef re-entrancy guard present in OAuthFinish.jsx. UI Quick Task box on Projects page: vague 'fix it' renders the exact clarifying toast; concrete task submission is unblocked. 12/12 backend tests pass; 3/3 frontend OAuthFinish forced-scenarios pass; 2/2 Projects UI ambiguity flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: _is_ambiguous_task uses word count < 4 as a fallback which is a reasonable heuristic; 'help' (1 word) and 'do stuff' (2 words) are correctly caught. No obvious edge cases that would leak vague through.

Reachability gate is only active when github_pat is present AND file_refs is non-empty. If github_pat is missing, the code falls through to llm_diagnosis with empty file_contents — the gate does NOT cover that case. Consider whether an unreachable/unauthenticated repo should also honestly say 'I can't read your repo' rather than diagnose from zero content. Not a regression of this round, but worth noting.

OAuthFinish.jsx sets `hasRun.current = true` inside `run()` after the first if-check. Since setState/effects run synchronously per invocation and hasRun is set before any await, this correctly prevents double-invoke in React StrictMode / remount races.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing fixture project aurem-demo/frontend (any project works since gate is checked before project resolution).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API prefix is /api/aurem-dev (not /api). Login endpoint: /api/aurem-dev/auth/login. Ambiguity-gate is checked in cto_projects.py::submit_task at line ~1658 BEFORE budget/rate-limit. Reachability gate in services/mode_d_debugger.py at line ~700 — requires github_pat + non-empty file_refs + all read_file returns empty. If retesting Mode D via full HTTP chat endpoint, note is_debug_request() requires hard/soft signals — a stack-trace-style line 'TypeError ... at path/file.jsx:42:17' works.
rca of the issue: Not applicable — this iteration was verification of a completed fix, not bug reproduction. All three gates behave exactly as specified in the review request.
